title: CommissionScheduleAssignment - Data API
description: Represents the commission calculation applicable to a specific product or producer for one or multiple commissionable events.

CommissionableEventType.properties: Create, Filter, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Update
CommissionableEventType.description: The event that results in the commission calculation. Possible values are: Contracting Endorsement Issue Policy Policy Issuance

CommissionScheduleId.description: The ID of the associated Commission Schedule, which is the commission calculation tied to the product or producer. This is a relationship field.

EffectiveEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EffectiveEndDate.description: The last date when the Commission Schedule is in effect for the product or producer.

EffectiveStartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EffectiveStartDate.description: The first date when the Commission Schedule is in effect for the product or producer.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

MaxCommissionAmount.description: The maximum commission calculated for the product or producer for a commissionable event. Constrains the output from the Commission Schedule.

MaxCommissionRate.description: The maximum commission rate that a producer receives for a commissionable event.

MinCommissionAmount.description: The minimum commission calculated for the product or producer for a commissionable event. Constrains the output from the Commission Schedule.

MinCommissionRate.description: The minimum commission rate that a producer receives for a commissionable event.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Name of the Commission Schedule Assignment.

ProducerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProducerId.description: The producer, broker, brokerage, or other user who receives the commission. This is a relationship field.

Product2Id.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Product2Id.description: The product for which commissions are calculated. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
